Merged, thank you.

The check is the right one, including the `keyCode === 229` fallback, and you applied it consistently across all seven input sites instead of just the one that bit you. The acceptance test is appreciated too.

This matters more than it might look. We recently filled in the missing translations for Japanese, Korean and Chinese, so we expect more people typing with an IME, and a swallowed Enter mid composition is a miserable first impression.

Removing --prod was left over from my troubleshooting (I tried that first based on the earlier suggestion here, and it didn't help). The actual fix is only the HOME line. I've since tested ExecStart=/usr/bin/node app.js --prod together with Environment=HOME=/root and it starts fine too. With Environment=NODE_ENV=production set, --prod is redundant anyway, since both put Sails in production mode, so either form works.
I might try https://github.com/pallets-eco/flask-security as a potential replacement.

@joonass-visma I had the same issue, this is fixed in source by #436, but the published 2.6.1 bundles were built before that merge (headless/index.mjs is byte-identical to 2.6.0's), so it will be resolved once a rebuilt release ships 🙌
